description: Free search with no sign-in for items, services and directory businesses by coordinates and optional city. Returns offerings, unconfirmed website_items, directory.businesses, data_coverage and optional wider_search/city status. Offering rows include title, businessId, nullable priceCents/price, price_display, distanceMeters, source_type and data_age_seconds; directory rows include display_name, storefront address, phone, website, matchedOn and `missing`. directory.gaps summarizes omissions. Availability requires connector data within its freshness window, a non-listed plan, BILLING_ENTITLEMENTS_ENABLED=true and STRIPE_MODE=test/live; directory and website matches do not confirm stock or slots. Empty results describe this query only. Preserve source labels, unknown dates, contact/request-area next steps and city warnings. Virtual businesses have no street or directions. Optional research_errand URLs share a two-page limit per answer; use only relevant research_fact_types.
name: discover_local
title: Discover local offerings and businesses
